title: Dead London — bait the fighting tripod
description: Bait the ray at a previous landing, then attack the tripod's lowered brace.
scene: Scene: compact dry cobbled combat apron at Regent's Park edge, framed by ruined Victorian brick frontage, black iron fence fragments and pale decaying red weed. Close overhead floor view, no skyline. The colossal fighting machine is THREE-LEGGED: three support roots are suggested around the upper scene, but the hood folds/leans into the top third to keep its camera-like parabolic ray apparatus locally visible at current zoom. One bent near leg lowers its joint brace to slash height at upper-right beside the central player. The mirror has locked a short pale double-line warning corridor into a former dash landing at lower-left, marked by a dashed circular outline only. Player has dashed beside the lowered leg, safely outside the full lane, and is beginning one short blade strike at the exposed brace. Leave another broad unoccupied landing behind the player. No distant head target, no tiny protagonist, no shooting up at a giant monster.
